title: #18. Establishment Of The State 1
arabic:
اَلْحَمْدُ لله رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنْ ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراَّ

أما بعد، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته هَذَالْمَنْزِلْ لَئِنْ قَعَدْنَا وَالنَّبِيُّ يَعْمَلْ ذَلِكَ مِنَّا اَلْعَمَلٌ مُدَلَّلْ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says;

الَّذِينَ إِنْ مَكَّنَّاهُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ فِي بُيُوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالْآصَالِ۝

رِجَالٌ لَا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ لَا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَارَةٌ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِۙ

يَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ وَالْأَبْصَارُ۝

ليَجْزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَيَزِيدَهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ۝

اِذَ زَخْرَفْتُمْ مَسَاجِدَكُمْ، وَزَوَّقْتُمْ مَصَاحِفَكُمْ فَالَدمَارُعَلَيْكُمْ صَلَاةٌ فِيْ مَسْجِدِيْ هَذَ اَفْضَلْ مِنْ اَلْفِ صَلَاتٍ فِيْمَا سِوَاه اِلَّا مَسْجِدِالْحَرَامْ

لَا تُشَدُّ الرِحَالُ اِلَّا اِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسْاجِدْ، مَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامْ، وَمَسْجِدِ الْاَقْصَى، وَمَسْجِدِيْ هَذَا مَا بَيْنَ بَيْتِيْ وَمِمْبَرِي ْرَوْضَةٌ مِنْ الرِّيَاضِ الْجَنَّة، وَمِمْبَرِيْ عَلَى حَوْضِي

اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ

أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاةِ ، حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاحِ ، حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاحِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلاةِ ،حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلاحِ

قَدْ قَامَت الصَّلَاةْ، قَدْ قَامَت الصَّلَاةْ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رُوْيَا حَقْ اَلصُّفَّهْ مَكَانٌ فِيْ مُؤَخِّرِ الْمٍسْجِدِ النَبْوِيْ

مُظلَّلْ اُعِدَّ لِنُزُوْلِ الْغُرْبَآءْ فِيْهِ مِمَّنْ لَّا مَأوى لَه’وَلَا أهل وَاَهْلُ الصُّفَّةِ ضيَافُ الْاِسْلَامِ لَا يَأوُوْنَ عَلَى اَهْلٍ وَلَامَالٍ وَلَا عَلَى اَحَدْ

اِنَّكُمْ تَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّ اَبَا هُرَيْرَهْ يُكْثِرُالْحَدِيْثَ اَلرَّسُوْلِ الله، وَتَقُوْلُوْنَ مَا بَال الْمُهَاجِرِيْنَ وَلْاَنْصَارْ لَا يُحَدِّثُوْنَ عَنْ رسول الله بِمِثْلِ حَدِيْثِ اَبُو هُرَيْرَه

وَاِنَّ اِخْوَةِ مِنَّ الْمُهَاجِرِيْنَ  كَانَ يَشْغَلُهُمْ صَفق الْاَسْوَاقِ وَكُنْتُ اَلْزَمُ رَسُوُلَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم علَى مِلْءِ بَطْنِي،

فأشْهَدُ إذَا غَابُوا، وأَحْفَظُ إذَا نَسُوا وكانَ يَشْغَلُ إخْوَتي مِنَ الأنْصَارِ عَمَلُ أمْوَالِهِمْ، وكُنْتُ امْرَأً مِسْكِينًا مِن مَسَاكِينِ الصُّفَّةِ، أعِي حِينَ يَنْسَوْنَ

وَالله! لَا اُعْطِيْكُمْ وَأدع اَهْلُ الصُّفَّةِ  تَطْوِيْ بُطُوْنَهُمْ مِنَّ الْجُوْعِ لَا اَجِدُ مَااُنْفِقُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَكِنْ اَبِيْعَهُمْ وَاُنْفِق عَلَيْهِمْ اَثْمَانُهُمْ

كَانَ رَسُوْلَ الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يُشْغَلْ فَاِذَا قَدِمَ رَجُلٌ مُهَاجِر عَلَى رَسُوْل الله صلى الله عليه وسلم دَفْعَه’ اِلَى رَجُلِ مِّنَّا  يُعَلِّمُهُ الْقُرْآنْ

فَدَفَعَ اِلَيَّ رَسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلً وَكَانَ مَعَيْ فِيْ الْبَيْتْ وَعشِيْهِ عشَاء اَهْلِ الْبَيْتْ وَكُنْتُ اُقْرِءُه’الْقُرْآنَ

Allahعَزّوجَلّ, says; وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا ۚ وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنْتُمْ أَعْدَاءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ

فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ بِنِعْمَتِهِ إِخْوَانًا وَكُنْتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِنَ النَّارِ فَأَنْقَذَكُمْ مِنْهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ آيَاتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ۝

وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنْفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۝

وَالَّذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو الدَّارَ وَالْإِيمَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِمَّا أُوتُوا

وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ ۚ وَمَنْ يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ۝

بَارَكَ اللهُ لَكَ فِيْ اَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكْ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاءْ صَدَقَ سلمان, اِنَّ لِنَفْسِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَّا، وَاِنَّ لِاَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَّا،

وَاِنَّ لِرَبِّكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَّا اِنَّ لِرَبِّكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَّا واِنَّ لِنَفْسِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَّا وَاِنَّ لِاَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَّا فَاَعْطِ كُلَّ ذِيْ حَقٍ حَقَّه

اِقْسِمْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَنَا اِخْوَانِ نَّخِيء تَكْفُوْنَنَا الْمُؤنة وَنُشْرِكُكُمْ فِيْ الثَّمَرَ يَا رَسُوْل الله، مَا رَاَيْنَا مِثْلَ قَوْمٍ قَدِمْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ اَحْسَنَ مُواسَاتٍ فِيْ قَلِيْلٍ،

وَلَا اَحْسَنَ بَذلا فِيْ كَثِيْرٍ وَلَقَدْ كَفَوْنَا الْمُؤنَة وَ اَشْرَكُوْنَا  فِيْ الْمَهْنَة، حَتَّى لَقَدْ حَسِبْنَا اَنْ يَذْهَبُوا بِالْاَجْرِ كُلَّه

لَا يَشْكُرُالنَّاسْ لَا يَشْكُرُالله Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْ بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا مَعَكُمْ فَأُولَٰئِكَ مِنْكُمْ ۚ

وَأُولُو الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا آبَاءَكُمْ وَإِخْوَانَكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنِ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْكُفْرَ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ ۚ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ مِنْكُمْ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِمَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ

يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۙ أَنْ تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا إنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي ۚ

تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُمْ ۚ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ۝

إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالسُّوءِ وَوَدُّوا

وَوَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ۝

لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَا أَوْلَادُكُمْ ۚ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۘ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ مِنْكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ ۗ

إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنْ تُطِيعُوا فَرِيقًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِنْ تُطِيعُوا فَرِيقًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ يَرُدُّوكُمْ بَعْدَ إِيمَانِكُمْ كَافِرِينَ۝

وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنْتُمْ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُ ۗ وَمَنْ يَعْتَصِمْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِيَ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ۝

لا اله الا الله لا اله اِلَّا الله لا اله الا الله Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِنَّمَا وَلِيُّكُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ

الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُمْ رَاكِعُونَ۝

وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَإِنَّ حِزْبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ۖ

سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ

فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا۝

The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madina period, volume 1 by Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki What was the first project that Rasool Allah ﷺ started when he reached to Madina.?

If we take the four projects, the first four projects that Rasool Allah ﷺ started with in Madina, these four projects are; Number one, The Masjid(مسجد).

Number two, establishing brotherhood.

Number three, a covenant that would govern the relationships between the different people of Madina.

And number four, the establishment of the army.

We start with the first project and that is the Masjid(مسجد).

The Masijd(مسجد) was the first thing Rasool Allah ﷺ did, when he arrived to Madina.

And you can notice that it was the first thing, he did when he arrived at Qubaa(قباء), the first thing he did when he arrived to Qubaa(قباء), was to build the Masjid(مسجد) of Qubaa(قباء).

And the first thing, he does inside Madina is to build Al-Masjid-e-Nabawi(ألمسجد النبوي).

This is because Al-Masjid(المسجد), is the center of learning for the Muslims, and that's why it was the first project that Rasool Allah ﷺ started with in Madina.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had Dar-Ul-Arqam(دارالارقم) in Makkah, and now he's building the Masjid(مسجد), which expands the role of Dar-Ul-Arqam(دارالارقم).

Dar-Ul-Arqam(دارالارقم) was a secret location, where the Muslims would meet and pray and teach.

But now since Rasool Allah ﷺ has established an Islamic State, it wasn't in a secret location, anymore.

It was public, it was the Masjid(مسجد), Al-Masjid-e-Nabawi(ألمسجد النبوي).

How did he choose the location?

Rasool Allah ﷺ was riding his camel and people were pulling it, everyone wants to pull it towards their direction.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Leave it, because it has been commanded by Allah.

So, the camel was going through the streets of Madina and then it stopped in this particular location, which was a field for drying dates, when dates become ripe, they need to be dried and they would do that in an open place,

so that it would be exposed to the sun and the water inside the dates would evaporate.

And this field belonged to two orphans in Madina.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ when the camel chose this location, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: This is our place.

This is the location of the Masjid(مسجد).

And this is the location of his living quarters.

Rasool Allah wanted to buy this area from the two orphans.

They said: No, we're going to give it to you, O Rasool Allah, we're going to give it to you.

There were some graves in there, graves of Mushrikeen(مشركين), Rasool Allah ﷺ uncovered those graves and changed the location.

And they started building Al-Masjid-e-Nabawi(ألمسجد النبوي), they built it from mud bricks and the roof was palm leaves.

So, when it would rain, it would drop right, on top of their heads, very simple, the floor was sand.

Even though it was very simple, it was the most blessed Masjid(مسجد), that's where the first generation graduated from.

Rasool Allah ﷺ joined the Sahabah in the building of the Masjid(مسجد), he was giving them an example of himself joining and working.

So, the poet among them said; If we sit down, while the Messenger of Allah is working that is a misguided act on our behalf.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ himself was carrying the bricks and building the Masjid(مسجد) with the Sahabahرضي الله عنهم.

Some lessons from the building of the Masjid(مسجد).

Number one, the Masjid(مسجد) is the first thing that Rasool Allah ﷺ did.

The ones, whom when we establish in land, they would establish prayers, when we give them authority in land they would establish Salah(صلاة).

So, Allah has given Rasool Allah ﷺ and the Sahabah authority in the land.

The first thing they did is to establish Salah(صلاة), and by establishing the Masjid(مسجد), they're establishing the center of Salah(صلاة).

What is the role of the Masjid(مسجد).?

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says in Qur'an; "In houses which Allah has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned there in, exalting Him within them in the morning and evening are men,

whom neither commerce nor sale distracts them from performance of prayer and giving Zakah(زكواة) They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will turn about

that Allah may reward them the best of what they did, and increase them from His bounty.

And Allah gives provision to whom He wills, without account." So, the Masjid(مسجد) is just a building.

But the real essence of the Masjid(مسجد) are the people inside the Masjid(مسجد).

That is the spirit of the Masjid(مسجد).

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; the house of Allah in them are men, who are not distracted by commerce, they're not distracted by money, they're not distracted by making a living.

They worship Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

They do make a living, they do work, they do business, but when they are in the Masjid(مسجد), they are remembering Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Duniya(دنيا) is not on their mind.

So, the Masjid(مسجد) is a place of prayer and remembrance of Allah.

That's the first and most important role of the Masjid(مسجد), it's a place of Zikr(ذكر) and a place of Salah(صلاة).

Number two, the Masjid(مسجد) is the center of learning, Dar-Ul-Arqam(دارالارقم) in Makkah and Masjid Al-Nabwi(مسجدالنبوي) in Madina That is where Rasool Allah ﷺ would give his Khutba(خطبه) that's where he would give his talks,

that's where the Sahabah(صحابه) would come together in circles and studying the book of Allah.

Rasool Allah ﷺ says in the Hadith(حديث), if people come together in the house of Allah, studying the book of Allahعَزّوجَلّ and reading it, Allah will give them four things,

1. Sakeena(سكينه), tranquility, 2.  Mercy(رحمه), and number three, angels would surround them and Number four, Allah will mention their names in a gathering better than theirs.

Number three, the Masjid(مسجد) is a place for Muslims to meet, so it plays a social role.

And Muslims who pray Jam'maa(جماعة) would meet five times a day, that strengthens the bonds of brotherhood.

They also meet on Jum'ah(جمعه) and the word Jum'ah(جمعه) and Jama'a(جماعه), it mean congregation, people coming together, it's a gathering.

Number four, the Masjid(مسجد) was a dwelling for the traveler, and the poor, and we're going to talk about Ahl-Us-Suffah(أهل الصفه), and the special place that was built for them, in the Masjid(مسجد).

Number five, the Masjid(مسجد) was a place where the armies would be sent out from.

That is where the Luw'aa(لؤوا) would be set, the banners or the standards of war, would be handed out inside the Masjid(مسجد).

And finally, Masjid(مسجد) is place for Da'wah(دعوة), when the Christians from Najraan(نجران) in Yemen came to visit Rasool Allah ﷺ where did they stay?

They didn't stay in hotels.

They weren't refused, they weren't banned from entering the Masjid(مسجد), they lived in the Masjid(مسجد).

They lived in the Masjid(مسجد), so that they can see the Muslims pray.

They could hold their discussions and conversations with Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, the Masjid(مسجد) plays an important role, in Da'wah(دعوة).

We said that the Masjid(مسجد) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, Al-Masjid-e-Nabawi(المسجدالنبوي) was simple.

It didn't have all of those fancy decorations.

So, what's the ruling on those decorations to start with.?

The scholars say that Tash'heed(تشهيد) is allowed, while Zakhrafah(زخرفه) and Naqsh(نقش) is not.

Tash'heed(تشهيد), means having good building material, good building for the Masjid(مسجد) itself.

So, the Masjid(مسجد) of Rasool Allah was made out of mud bricks, but later on, they built it from stone, they had some pillars in there, that is allowed

That was allowed, having a roof made out of wood.

In one of the expenses of Al-Masjid-e-Nabwi(ألمسجد النبوي) that was allowed, because these things happened during the time of Al-Khulafah-Ar-Rashidoon(خلفاءالراشدون).

But the decoration of the Masjid(مسجد), the scholars have a difference of opinion, some of them say it is Haram(حرام) and some say it's Makrooh(مكروه).

Now even the ones who say that it is Makrooh(مكروه), they say that if somebody designates money to be used as a Waqf(وقف), as a trust for a Masjid(مسجد),

it is Haram(حرام) to use that money to decorate the Masjid(مسجد), it needs to go into the building of the Masjid(مسجد).

So, Abu Darda(ابودرداء) for example, he says; If you decorate your Qur'an, the Mus'haf(مصحف) and you decorate your Masjid(مسجد), then you would perish,

because that's the sign of preferring symbols over substance.

The Masjid-e-Nabwi(ألمسجد النبوي) was simple, mud bricks.

But the best men of this Ummah(امة) graduated from Al-Masjid-e-Nabwi(ألمسجدالنبوي).

And now we have huge buildings, magnificent.

But what are the results, they merely show the sophisticated architecture and all the money that was thrown into, those huge buildings, that's about it.

Another lesson Tarbiyah(تربيعة) through practice, Rasool Allah ﷺ was teaching the Sahabah(صحابه) by practicing.

He was building the Masjid(مسجد) with them.

He wasn't just giving them instructions from a high place.

He was joining them in the field and showing them, what it means to be a Muslim.

The next lesson, specialization is respected in Islam.

And people should be told to do what they're capable of doing and what they're best at.

This is an important thing for the Muslim leader to learn.

Because when they were building the Masjid-Al-Nabwi(مسجد النبوي), there was a man from Najd(نجد) who was with them.

And this man was a builder, he himself.

So, he asked Rasool Allah ﷺ, should I join you in carrying the bricks?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said, No, do not carry the bricks with us.

You make the mixture for the bricks and make them and because other people can carry the bricks, but you need to focus on what you are best at.

And that is making these bricks for us.

So, if this man was carrying bricks, you would have people who are not as expert as he was, mixing the bricks.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ would devote him to this act and have other people carry the bricks.

So in our Islamic work, not everybody has to do the same thing.

Not everyone needs to be a good Daiyah(داعيه).

Not everyone needs to become a scholar.

Not everyone needs to be an Imaam(إمام).

Let people do what they're capable of doing because Allah gives different people different gifts.

And the good leader is the one, who recognizes the abilities of his followers and advises them, and how to strengthen the gifts that Allahسبحانه و تعالى has given them

and how to take advantage of those abilities for the sake of the benefit of Islam and Muslims.

Some virtues of Al-Masjid-Al-Nabwi(مسجد النبوي) Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Rasool Allah ﷺ says in the Hadith(حديث) narrated by Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ)

one Salah(صلاة) in my Masjid(مسجد) it is better than 1000 Salah(صلاة) in any other Masjid except Masjid Al-Haraam(مسجدالحرام), Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

Which means that if you pray one Ishaa(عشاء) for example, in Al-Masjid-Al-Nabwi(مسجد النبوي), it counts as if you have prayed Ishaa(عشاء) for 83 years in any other Masjid(مسجد),

so if you're praying Ishaa(عشاء) every evening in another Masjid(مسجد) for 83 years, that counts as one Ishaa(عشاء) in Al-Masjid-Al-Nabwi(مسجد النبوي),

that's how much blessing there is, in praying in Al-Masjid-Al-Nabwi(مسجد النبوي).

Rasool Allah ﷺ also says; You should not travel to visit a Masjid(مسجد), except if it is one of three Masjid(مسجد)s Al-Masjid Al-Haraam(مسجدالحرام), Al-Ka'aba(ألكعبه), Al-Masjid Al-Aksaa(مسجد الاقصى) in Jerusalem

and this Masjid(مسجد) of mine, Al-Masjid-Al-Nabwi(مسجد النبوي).

And Rasool Allah ﷺ says: Rasool Allah ﷺ says, between my house and my pulpit is a garden from among the gardens of Paradise and my pulpit is on my pool, Al-Kauser(ألكوثر),

the pool that Rasool Allah ﷺ would be given on the Day of Judgment and this is in Al-Bukhari(بخاريْ).

Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد), one of the Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ saw a dream, at that time Rasool Allah ﷺ has finished constructing the Masjid Al-Nabawi(مسجد النبوي)

and now they were thinking about ways to invite people to the prayer.

So, some suggestions were using a bell, similar to what the Christians do.

Another suggestion was to blow a horn, such as the Jews at least in Madina, that's what Jews would do.

So, Abdullah Bin Zaidرضي الله عنه saw a dream, He saw a man carrying a bell.

So, Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد) told him; O servant of Allah, how much would you sell that bell for?

The man said; Why do you want it?

Abdullah(عبدالله) said; to invite people to prayer.

So, the man said; How about if I suggest something better?

He said; What is it?

He said; You say, And then the man waited for a while and he came back to Abdullah(عبدالله) and said; And when you want to make Iqamah(إقامة), you say,

So, Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد), immediately went to Rasool Allah ﷺ and told him about the dream.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: It is a good dream, In Sha Allah(ان شاءالله).

This is a true dream.

Go with Bilal(بلال), and teach this to him.

Because his voice is better than yours.

Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد) is one who gets the credit for the Adhaan(آذان).

But Rasool Allah ﷺ did not allow him to make it, he told him to have Bilal(بلال) do it, because Bilal(بلال) has a better voice.

So they both, went together and Abdullah Bin Zaid(عبدالله بن زيد) was teaching Bilal(بلال) the Adhaan(آذان) that he was taught in his dream.

And when he finished, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) came running.

And he said: O Rasool Allah, I saw that dream.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Al-Hamdolillah(ألحمدلله), Al-Hamdolillah(ألحمدلله).

And this is an indication that it's a true dream, when more than one person sees the same dream, this an indication that it is a true dream.

So, this is the story of Adhaan(آذان).

And Adhaan(آذان) has became the most prominent symbol of Islam.

Now a days, you know that you are in a Muslim country or Muslim town if you hear Adhaan(آذان) So, this is the most prominent expression of Islam, or it's the most outwardly or public symbol of Islam.

What was the direction of Qibla(قبله) in the beginning.?

The direction of Qibla(قبله) was towards the north, because they used to pray towards Jerusalem.

A few months after Hijrah(هجرة), the Qibla(قبله) changed from the north towards the south, the exact opposite direction towards Makkah.

In the direction of the old Qibla(قبله), they built a shed, a roof that would provide shade, and the place under it would be called As-Suffah(ألصفه),

it would be called As-Suffah(ألصفه).

So what is As-Suffah(ألصفه) and who are Ahl-Us-Suffah(اهل الصفه).?

The definition of As-Suffah(ألصفه), according to Ibn Hajar(ابن هجر) is; Ibn Hajar(ابن هجر) says; As-Suffah(ألصفه) is a place, at the back of Al-Masjid Al-Nabawi(مسجدالنبوي), and it is shaded

and it was prepared for the foreigners, the ones who don'thave any family or any place to stay.

And Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) says; And this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ), Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) says, about As-Suffah(ألصفه), and he was one of them.

He says, As-Suffah(ألصفه) are the guests of Islam.

They are the ones who don't have any family or wealth to fall back on.

So they live in this place called As-Suffah(ألصفه).

Now not everyone who lived there was forced to live there because of their condition, some of them chose, volunteered to join Ahlus-Suffah(اهل الصفه), such as Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة)

because it seems that Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) did have wealth when he made Hijrah(هجرة), but he chose to devote his time to studying and therefore he lived with the people of As-Suffah(ألصفه).

He says about himself; He said, some people are saying, how come Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) narrates a lot of Hadith(حديث), while Al-Muhajireen(المهاجرين) and Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) don't.

Now we know that Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) was late in becoming Muslim.

So, how come he has narrated more Hadith(حديث) and everyone else.

Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) is number one in terms of narrating Hadith(حديث) compared to all of the other Sahabah(صحابه).

How come Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) knew more Ahadith(احاديث) than everybody else?

So he says, he's giving us the explanation, he's giving us the reason. He said; He said: My brothers from Al-Muhajireen(ألمهاجرين) were busy with business.

While I used to follow Rasool Allah ﷺ on an empty stomach I had nothing I was poor, but I was still following Rasool Allah ﷺ all the time.

So, I would attend, when they are absent, and I would remember when they would forget.

And then he said; The Ansaar(أنصار), were busy with their farms, and I was a poor man and I would remember, what they wouldn't.

Because he devoted his life to studying.

He had time to review the Ahadith(أحاديث) that he would hear from Rasool Allah ﷺ.

In fact, he says about himself that I split the night into three parts.

One part, I would sleep one part, I would pray and one part, I would review the Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, that I would hear during the day,

while the other Muhajireen Wal Ansaar(مهاجرين والأنصار) were busy, they had work to do.

The Muhajireen(مهاجرين) had business and the Ansaar(أنْصَار) had farms.

While Abu Hurairah(ابوهريرة) had nothing to preoccupy him from studying.

So he chose to be among Ahl-Us-Suffah(اهل الصفه), so that he could go and study with Rasool Allah ﷺ full time.

How would the people of As-Suffah(ألصفه) live.?

One source of livelihood for them, was the Sadaqaat(صدقات) that Rasool Allah ﷺ would sent to them.

When Rasool Allah ﷺ would receive Sadaqah(صدقه), he would send it to them.

And when he would receive a gift, he would take some of it and give them the rest.

Now the Sadaqah(صدقه) you notice that I didn't say that Rasool Ullah would take any of it because Rasool Allah ﷺ did not accept Sadaqah(صدقه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ would encourage the well off Sahabah(صحابه) to invite them.

One of the Ansaar(أنْصَار) Ya'eesh Al-Ghaffari(يعيش ألغفاري), he said; My father was from among the people of As-Suffah(ألصفه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered the Sahabah(صحابه) to invite Ahlus-Suffah(أهل الصفه) to their houses.

So, they came and every one of these Sahabah(صحابه) took some of us away, until only five of us were left.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ told us all to go with him, to his house, and he fed us.

And in another narration, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Whoever has food enough for two people should take a third with him, and will have her has enough food for four people, he should take a fifth or sixth person with him.

So, I just want to comment here and say that, you notice that sacrifice and generosity was part of Islam from various early on.

In fact, from Makkah from day one, Allahعَزّوجَلّ has revealed Ayaat(آيات) about taking care of the orphan, taking care of the needy, being generous towards the guest.

All of these are Ibadaat(عبادات) that were encouraged from day one.

So, we shouldn't think that being a Muslim does not demand sacrifice.

There's no free ride, if we want Jannah(جنة), if we seek to please Allahعَزّوجَلّ, we have to sacrifice for Allahعَزّوجَلّ, we have to give and giving was part of being a Muslim from day one.

These Sahabah(صحابه) who were inviting others, they weren't millionaires.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was saying; if you have enough food for two people, only two people, you take a third person with you.

So, he's telling the Sahabah(صحابه) to invite others to their houses, when they only have enough food for two people.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would take care of them, even though others would come to him for needs.

An example was Fatimaرضي الله عنها , the daughter of Rasool Allah ﷺ, the most beloved to the Messenger of Allah.

She had to do all of the hard work at home until her hands were becoming injured, and coarse.

So, Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) told her that your father has received some savvy(سوي), savvy are slaves.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ says; Accept from the one of them who does good and overlook their mistakes, of the ones who commit them.

In the name of Allah, I love you, I love Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار).

And then he said, Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) have done their part.

Now it's your turn.

He's talking to the rest of the people and telling them, Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) have done, what they need to do.

It's now your turn to do that to fulfill your duties towards this religion.

So, this is the part regarding the second important project of Rasool Allah ﷺ, in Madina, and that is establishing a community based on brotherhood,

so I think it's clear from these Ayaat(آيات).

And what we mentioned, the importance of developing brotherhood among the Ummah(امة).

Keep in mind that Shaitan(شيطان) is always trying to disunite us.

So, we have to fight this Waswasa(وسوسه), and we have to be aware that the Waswasa(وسوسه) is there.

We have to understand that there's someone plotting against us, being brothers.

In order to fight that enemy, Shaitan(شيطان), who's always trying to cause disunity among us.

I mean, one single word, Shaitan(شيطان) can use it to cause a dispute between a Muslim and his brother.

And that's why Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; Allahعَزّوجَلّ is saying to Muhammadﷺ, tell my servants to speak good, because Shaitan(شيطان) is there to cause disunity among them.

And Shaitan(شيطان) is indeed your enemy.

So, Allah is saying that he could take one of those words that you said and cause your brother to misinterpret it and then causea problem.

So Be careful, of what you say.

The third project which Rasool Allah ﷺ, started when he arrived to Madina was what is called Al-Waseeqah(اَلْوَثِيْقَة) or the covenant, the document.

This was a document that was written to govern the relationship between the different communities in Madina.

I will read to the terms of this agreement.

It is narrated by Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ); The Messenger of Allah wrote a contract between the immigrants and the helpers, in which he expressed conciliation.

These are the words of Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ), I'll start with the terms of the agreement itself.

It says, "In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Beneficent.

This is a document from Muhammad(محمد), The unlettered Prophet, between the believers and Muslims of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and Yasrib(يثرب), and their followers, allies and supporters

establishing that they are one nation apart from all others.

The immigrants from Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) will maintain their current practice and will honor Blood Money contracts between themselves and will treat their weaker members with kindness and justice.

The Bannu Auf(بنو عوف) shall maintain their current practice, and honor their former Blood Money contracts, each party treating their weaker members with kindness and justice among all believers.

He then made reference to each clan of the helpers, and to the families of each home, mentioning the Bannu Sa'adah(بنو سعاد), the Bannu Jusham(بنو جشم), the Bannu Najjar(بنو نجار), the Bannu Amr Bin Auf( بنو أمر بن عوف) and Bannu Nabit(بنو نابت).

He went on to say, the believers shall not leave anyone among them burdened by debts without giving to him in kindness, and in paying for him, any ransom money or blood money he owes.

A believer will not ally with any freedman of a second believer against that man.

Pious believers act against any of their own who practice evil or seek to bring harm, sin, aggression, or corruption among believers.

Believers will unite against anyone doing this, even if he be one of their own sons.

No believers shall kill any believer for any non believer, nor shall he help any non believer against a believer.

So, you can notice here that this concept of community based on faith, Is there.

No believers shall kill any believer for any non believer, nor shall he help any non believer against a believer.

Allah's protection is all one, the least of them can offer protection to others.

Believers are allies to one another, excluding others, meaning we are a nation apart from anyone, everyone else.

Whatever Jews follow us, shall receive help and equality.

They shall not be maltreated, nor will help be afforded others against them.

No peace shall be accepted for anyone believer to the exclusion of others, when the battle is for Allah's cause.

Among them equality and justice must prevail.

In every expedition we engage in, riders shall take turns on their mounts.

Believers shall avenge one another for bloodshed in Allah's cause.

Believers who are pious are well guided on the straightest of paths.

No Polytheist shall be allowed to offer protection for the property or persons of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), nor try to interfere with any believer.

Anyone who has clearly aggressed against and caused the death of any believer shall be subject to retaliation for him, unless the dead man's executor can be satisfied.

Believers as a whole shall take action against him, and no excuse for they're not doing so will be acceptable.

It shall not be permissible for any believer who has accepted what is in this document, and who believes in Allah, in Judgment Day to give help or shelter to any wrongdoer.

Any believer who does this shall be the object of Allah's, curses and anger on Judgment Day and neither compensation, nor excuse will be acceptable from him.

Any matter in which you disagree, must be referred to Allah Almighty and glorious is He and to Muhammadﷺ.

The Jews shall pay expenses along with the Muslims, so long as they are allied in warfare.

The Jews of Banni Auf(بني عوف) are one nation with the believers, the Jews shall have their religion, the Muslims their own.

This applies to their freedmen and to themselves, except for those who commit sins and are unjust.

Such persons only harm themselves and their families.

What applies to Banni Auf(بني عوف) shall also apply to the Jews of Bannu Najjar(بنو نجار), Bannu Al-Hariss(بنو الحارث), Bannu Sa'adah(بنو سعاده), Bannu Jusham(بنو جشم), Bannu Al-Aos(بنو الاوس),

Bannu Al-Sa'alabah(بنو ثعلبه) and Jufna(جفنه) and Bannu Shutaibah(شطيبه).

The close associates of the Jews shall be viewed as themselves.

None of them shall go to war without Muhammad's permission.

However he is not there by constraints from taking revenge for injury.

Whoever attacks another may do so, to protect himself and his family, but act not unjustly for Allah condemns such acts.

The Jews shall bear their own expenses, the Muslims their's, each must help one another against any, who fight those who adopt this document.

They must give one another advice and consultation and do good and avoid evil.

A man is not held blameworthy on behalf of his ally.

Help must be given to those wronged.

The center of Yasrib(يثرب) shall be a sanctuary.

For those who agree to this document.

One's neighbor shall be treated as one self, without being harmed or sinned against.

No property shall be encroached upon without the permission of its owner.

In the case of any dispute, or incident, occurring between those agreeing to this document and involving consequences likely to be harmful, the matter must be referred to Allah and to Muhammad(محمد), the Messenger of Allah.

Allah acknowledges what is very good and very pious in this document, Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and those who helped them shall receive no protection.

Those accepting this document must help one another against anyone attacking Yasrib(يثرب).

If they are called upon to make peace, and do so and keep to it, they will be making peace.

If they make similar demand, then it is up to the Muslims to agree except, if the warfare is over the faith.

Each participant shall receive whatever portion is due to him, from his own sides winnings.

This document will not provide protection for anyone sinful or unjust.

Whoever goes to war will be safe or whoever leaves will be safe.

Whoever stays in the town will be safe, except for those who have sinned or been unjust.

Allah provides protection for those, who are good and pious." So, this was the document that Rasool Allah ﷺ wrote to govern the rules, or to govern the communities in Madina.

In sha Allah Ta'ala(اِن شَاالله تعالى) , we'll make some brief comments on this document tomorrow.
